banner.team: A platform baseline, trained by the TinyBrains team
banner.lineLabel: Open rating this season, from {first} to {last}

testing.title: v{v} is in admission.
testing.body: We are fetching the files, checking them against the hashes you declared, and measuring the model and manifest into a weight class.
testing.bodyAttempt: We are fetching the files, checking them against the hashes you declared, and measuring the model and manifest into a weight class. This is attempt {attempt}.

waiting.title: v{v} is waiting for its trial.
waiting.admitted: Admitted {date}. It replaces the playing version if it finishes its trial under the strike limit, win or lose.
waiting.queued: Admitted {date}, with a trial queued against a baseline on {map}. It replaces the playing version if it finishes the trial under the strike limit, win or lose.
waiting.waited: Admitted {date}, with a trial queued against a baseline on {map}. It has waited {waited}. It replaces the playing version if it finishes the trial under the strike limit, win or lose.

trial.title: v{v} is in its trial.
trial.body: It is playing a baseline on {map} now. It replaces the playing version if it finishes the trial under the strike limit, win or lose.

rejected.title: v{v} was rejected at admission.
rejected.noReason: Admission refused it without recording a reason. That fault is ours and says nothing about your model.

season.title: This season
season.lastFive: The last five results, newest first
season.rankWas: #{rank} on Open, was #{was} a week ago
season.rankNone: not on the Open ladder now

story.label: The story
story.emptyBody: A story is the long version: what you tried, what failed, what the adapter sees. An admin can feature it on the home page.

held.title: Your edit is waiting for review.
held.body: It uses {word}, so an admin reads it before it goes up. Until then everyone else reads the text below.
held.first: It uses {word}, so an admin reads it before it goes up. Until then nobody else sees a story here.

removed.title: An admin took this story down.
removed.body: Nobody else sees it, and an edit keeps it down: only an admin can put it back.

form.title: Title
form.bodyHint: Headings start with ##, list items with -, and links are [words](https://…). Up to 20,000 characters.

story.savedHeld: Saved. It uses {word}, so it waits for an admin before anyone else reads it.

errors.story_invalid: The story was not saved: the title must be one line of 1 to 80 characters and the text 1 to 20,000. Shorten it and save again.
errors.unknown_model: The story was not saved: you can no longer write to this model. Reload the page to see who owns it now.
errors.session_revoked: The story was not saved: you are signed out. Sign in again and save.
errors.fallback: The story was not saved: {message}. Try again in a moment.

matches.title: Matches
matches.chipLabel: Narrow the matches to one version
matches.empty: None of its versions has played yet. A version starts playing once it passes its trial.

versions.title: Versions
versions.subMine: including the ones only you can see
versions.empty: This model has no versions yet.
versions.missing: This model has no {version} that you can see.

note.label: The note for v{v}
note.hint: One line, up to 120 characters. Blank clears it.

errors.note_too_long: The note was not saved: it is longer than 120 characters. Shorten it and save again.
errors.note_word_listed: The note was not saved: it uses “{word}”, which the site does not allow. Reword it and save again.
errors.unknown_version: The note was not saved: you can no longer write to this version. Reload the page.
errors.session_revoked: The note was not saved: you are signed out. Sign in again and save.
errors.fallback: The note was not saved: {message}. Try again in a moment.

versions.loadingOwn: Loading the versions only you can see
versions.ownFailed: The versions only you can see did not load, so this list shows the public ones.

phases.active: It passed its trial and plays for this model.
phases.superseded: It passed its trial and played until a newer version replaced it.
phases.verified: Admitted and measured. The trial is the last step before it replaces the playing version.
phases.testing: Submitted. Admission is fetching the files and measuring them.
phases.rejected: Admission refused it, so it never reached a trial or played.
phases.disabled: A baseline, admitted and switched out of play by an admin. Its rating is kept.
